text:
I understand this is urgent, and I really want to help you. However, I need to authenticate your identity first before I can access any order information or tracking numbers. This is for your security and privacy protection.

Since you don't remember your email address, I can look you up using your name and zip code instead. Could you please provide me with:
- Your first name
- Your last name  
- Your zip code

This is the only way I can locate your account and help you with your order that was sent to Texas by mistake.
zh:
我理解这很紧急，我真的想帮助你。但是，在我能访问任何订单信息或追踪号之前，我需要先验证您的身份。这是为了您的安全和隐私保护。

由于您不记得电子邮件地址，我可以用您的姓名和邮政编码来查找您。您能提供给我吗：
- 您的名字
- 您的姓氏  
- 您的邮政编码

这是我能找到您的账户并帮助您处理被寄到德克萨斯州错误的订单的唯一方法。
